onboarding-visibility-copy: Public profiles help other people trust your Bites. You can stay private if you prefer.
onboarding-visibility-benefit-leaderboar: Join the leaderboard with your Bite count.
onboarding-visibility-benefit-followers: Let other food explorers follow you.
onboarding-visibility-benefit-trust: Give your Bites a recognizable author.
onboarding-visibility-private-copy: You appear as anonymous and stay off public social surfaces.
onboarding-visibility-public-copy: Your name, photo, followers, and Bite activity can be shown in the app.
onboarding-currency-copy: Prices are shown in your default currency. We picked one from your device — change it if it's not right.
onboarding-currency-default-hint: Used for every price you see and enter.
onboarding-currency-favorites-hint: Optional. Pinned to the top when you pick a currency.
onboarding-language-copy: Choose the language for the app. We picked one from your device.
onboarding-language-hint: The app switches language right away.
onboarding-location-copy: BiteTribe uses your position to show you what is worth eating right where you are.
onboarding-location-benefit-feed: See the Bites nearest to you in your feed.
onboarding-location-benefit-map: Find Bites around you on the map.
onboarding-location-benefit-distance: Know how far away a Bite is.
onboarding-location-benefit-create: Tag new Bites with the place you found them.
onboarding-location-denied: No location for now. Nearby Bites, the map, and distances will be limited.
onboarding-location-unsupported: Location is not available on this device. Your browser will ask when it is needed.
onboarding-notifications-copy: Notifications keep you in the loop about what happens around your Bites.
onboarding-notifications-benefit-ranking: Know when your leaderboard rank changes.
onboarding-notifications-benefit-followe: Hear about new followers and reactions.
onboarding-notifications-benefit-control: Turn them off at any time in settings.
onboarding-notifications-denied: No notifications for now. You can turn them on later in settings.
onboarding-notifications-unsupported: Notifications are not available on this device. You can turn them on later in the app.
onboarding-finish-copy: Your profile is ready. Here's what you can do next.
onboarding-finish-highlight-discover: Discover Bites shared by food lovers near you
onboarding-finish-highlight-create: Share your own Bites in just a couple of taps
onboarding-finish-highlight-explore: Explore the map, bucket lists, and the leaderboard
coach-home-feed-body: A Bite is a dish worth sharing. Scroll the feed to discover what people are eating around you.
coach-bite-details-body: If the creator is public, you’ll see who shared this Bite. You’ll also see its distance from your current position and its price in your preferred currency.
coach-bite-details-share-body: Send this Bite to friends through WhatsApp or another sharing app on your device.
coach-bite-details-navigation-body: Open this Bite in your navigation app and get directions straight to the place.
coach-bite-details-bucket-list-body: Add this Bite to an existing bucket list—or create a new one—so you remember what you want to try.
coach-home-menu-body: Open the menu to find your profile, bucket lists, leaderboard, gallery, marketplace, and settings.
coach-home-feed-controls-body: Search for Users, Bites, Restaurants, or Cities; open Bitemap to explore nearby; or sort by Distance for the closest Bites and Date for the newest Bites from anywhere.
coach-create-bite-body: Tap here to add your own Bite — a photo, a place, and a few words is all it takes.
coach-map-body: See Bites around you on the map and find great food nearby.
coach-bucket-lists-body: Save Bites you want to try into lists and tick them off as you go.
coach-bucket-list-swipe-body: Swipe a Bite to the left and tap the check to mark it as tried out. Swipe again to undo it.
coach-leaderboard-body: See who shares the most Bites and climb the ranks by sharing your own.
